notes: Non-blocking consistency note: T016-SR-015 and requirements.md section 2.2 phrase the offline constraint as 'no ... filesystem ... access', while fault_boundary_tests.cpp reads ten fixed committed headers with std::ifstream. The read is a bounded, deterministic repository inspection of committed artifacts at a build-time path, explicitly recorded (implementation.md section 5.1, T016-LIM-07) and does not touch ambient, secret, process, network, or legacy state. The intent (no ambient/unadmitted I/O) is satisfied; the CHK-20 scan pattern does not include <fstream>, so this is the single documented deviation from the literal wording rather than a functional defect.

Non-blocking verification-strength note: the forbidden-vocabulary scan matches only whole words (is_word_char treats '_' as a word character, fault_boundary_tests.cpp:42-45), so a compound identifier such as fault_campaign would evade it. The whole-word rule is justified at this revision because 'fault' would otherwise false-match the benign word 'default'; a future hardening could tokenize on '_' and case boundaries. This is a regression-sensitivity improvement, not a defect in the current evidence.

Non-blocking documentation note: detailed-design.md section 3.1 lists design helper signatures (core_digest(), make_item(fixture, sequence), a five-argument loopback_descriptor, make_contract returning std::optional) that differ in name/shape from the realized symbols recorded in implementation.md section 3.1 (kCoreDigest, CoreStackFixture::item(), a three-argument loopback_descriptor, make_contract returning Result). The pre-code design hedges these as '(design)'; the realized units are documented accurately in unit-specifications.md and implementation.md.

Non-blocking diagnostic note: NEG-10, NEG-15, and NEG-16 assert the exact ProviderOutcome (and, for NEG-15/16, the retained-slot/no-dispatch properties) rather than re-asserting the derived XCOM-PROV-E0xx code inline; the outcome-to-code mapping is verified exhaustively for all 29 outcomes plus interrupted_resource by CHK-13 (unit_tests.cpp:378-444), so the diagnostic is still pinned exactly.
